example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই পুরনো বাড়িটি এখন সম্পূর্ণ ভেস্তা হয়ে গেছে।
তার পরিকল্পনা ভেস্তা হয়ে গেল দুর্ঘটনার কারণে।
example_sentences_in_english: That old house has now become completely ruined.
His plan went to ruin due to the accident.
history: The associated proverb 'সাত নকলে আসল ভেস্তা' conveys that even multiple copies of something inherently flawed remain flawed, rooted in traditional Bengali wisdom.
note: The idiom often appears in the context of the proverb highlighting inevitable deterioration.
